column1: # Things Claude offered to save and you said no to. It reads this before
# offering again, so you should not get asked the same thing twice.
# Format: date<TAB>what it was<TAB>where it would have gone<TAB>no or not-now
#   no       — never ask about this again
#   not-now  — you were busy or still deciding. Fair to raise again later.
# Claude appends here when you decline. You can edit or empty it any time —
# deleting a line just means you are willing to be asked again.
